content.title: Boston Celtics vs Charlotte Hornets injury report: Who's playing, injured and questionable players, head-to-head records, team stats, and more (March 29, 2026)
content.text: Charlotte Hornets LaMelo Ball and Boston Celtics Jayson Tatum (Image via Getty).The Boston Celtics come into Charlotte on March 29, 2026, still leading the Atlantic Division with a 49-24 record. They are in a strong position in the playoff race, but their injury list is becoming a serious concern just before this game at Spectrum Center.At the same time, the Charlotte Hornets (39-35) are playing better and pushing for a playoff spot. They sit fourth in the Southeast Division and have a chance to take advantage of a weakened Celtics team. This game matters for both sides as the regular season is close to ending.Boston Celtics vs Charlotte Hornets injury report (March 29, 2026)Boston Celtics dealing with multiple injuries before gameBoston has several important players on the injury report, and that could change how they play tonight. • Nikola Vucevic is out as he recovers from surgery on his right ring finger. Israel Iran WarUS-Israel-Iran War News Live Updates: Middle East war day 30: Iran threatens to hit US universities; Kuwait responds to missile, drone attacksMissile Strike On Minab School: Iran names 2 US officers; US faces scrutinyIran Strikes Drag In Gulf: Tehran widens battlefield beyond US and Israel; West Asia faces new phaseHe is expected to miss more time into April. • Jayson Tatum is questionable because of right Achilles management after returning from injury. • Jaylen Brown is also questionable with Achilles and calf problems and has been day-to-day. • Derrick White is questionable with a knee contusion. • Neemias Queta is questionable due to a thumb sprain and may not play full minutes.If some of these players do not play, Boston will depend more on Sam Hauser, Payton Pritchard, Hugo Gonzalez, Baylor Scheierman, and Amari Williams.Charlotte Hornets mostly healthy with small concernsCharlotte is in better shape but still has a couple of minor issues. • Tidjane Salaun has a calf strain and may not play or will be a late decision. • Liam McNeeley is dealing with illness and will be checked closer to game time.Other key players like LaMelo Ball, Brandon Miller, Miles Bridges, Coby White, Josh Green, Grant Williams, Moussa Diabate, and Ryan Kalkbrenner are all available.Boston Celtics vs Charlotte Hornets Expected lineups and rotationsWhen fully fit, Boston usually starts Derrick White, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Sam Hauser, and Nikola Vucevic. Their bench includes Payton Pritchard, Neemias Queta, Luka Garza, Baylor Scheierman, Jordan Walsh, and Amari Williams.Charlotte will again run the offense through LaMelo Ball. Their likely starters are Ball, Coby White, Brandon Miller, Miles Bridges, and Ryan Kalkbrenner. Bench players include Tre Mann, Josh Green, Moussa Diabate, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel, Sion James, and Antonio Reeves.Boston Celtics vs Charlotte Hornets Head-to-head record and recent resultCategoryData All-time wins (Celtics) 66 All-time wins (Hornets) 19 Avg points (Celtics) ~106 Avg points (Hornets) ~97Charlotte won the first meeting this season on March 5, 2026, by 118-89. Kon Knueppel scored 20 points, and Derrick White scored 29 for Boston in that loss.Boston Celtics vs Charlotte Hornets Team stats comparison this seasonTeamRecordPPGOpp PPGKey Notes Celtics 49-24 ~117-119 ~108-110 Strong shooting, good defense, injuries affecting rotation Hornets 39-35 ~113-115 ~114-116 Ball leads offense, defense improvingBoston has been one of the best teams this season, but missing Vucevic affects their defense inside. Charlotte is improving, especially with its young players and better rim protection.Boston Celtics vs Charlotte Hornets Key matchups and what to watch (March 29, 2026)Boston’s lineup will decide how this game goes. If Tatum, Brown, or White do not play or are limited, the team will look very different.LaMelo Ball will be important, especially if Boston’s guards are not fully fit. Inside the paint, Charlotte may again take advantage of Boston’s lack of size.For Boston, a win helps them stay on top in the East. For Charlotte, this is a good chance to improve their position and move closer to a playoff spot.
